Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders. (a) The Company held its annual meeting of stockholders on May 15, 2026. (b) Of the 39,735,377 shares outstanding on the record date and entitled to vote at the meeting, 33,470,136 shares were present at the meeting in person or by proxy, constituting a quorum of eighty four percent (84%). The stockholders of the Company’s common stock considered and voted at the meeting upon the three Company proposals listed below. This report discloses the final voting results for the meeting. Proposal 1 – Elect seven director nominees to the Company’s board of directors The Company’s stockholders elected each of the individuals listed below as directors to serve until the next annual meeting of the Company and until their successors have been duly elected and qualified, or their earlier resignation.
